title: DVA-Neurons: Design and Verification of Adaptive LIF Neurons: From Single-Neuron Dynamics to Multi-Neuron Spiking Networks
abstract: arXiv:2609.22775v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer a promising path toward ultra-low-power artificial intelligence inference by emulating the event-driven computation of biological neurons. However, two challenges limit their practical deployment. First, fixed-parameter Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons lack the adaptation mechanisms observed in biology, where neurons modulate their excitability based on firing history. Second, scaling from single neurons to multi-neuron networks introduces challenges in synaptic weight distribution and inter-neuron spike routing that are absent in isolated designs. This paper addresses both issues through the extension, verification, and physical implementation of adaptive LIF neurons at three architectural scales. This work contributes: a 2nd-order neuron with two-stage synaptic filtering for richer temporal dynamics; a fully-connected 6-neuron spiking network with configurable weights (100 to 5) demonstrating

translated_abstract: 脉冲神经网络通过模拟生物神经元的事件驱动计算，为实现超低功耗的人工智能推理提供了一条有前景的路径。然而，有两个挑战限制了其实际部署。首先，固定参数的泄漏积分发放神经元缺乏生物学中观察到的适应机制，即神经元会根据发放历史调节其自身的兴奋性。其次，从单神经元扩展到多神经元网络会引入突触权重分布和神经元间脉冲路由方面的挑战，而这些挑战在孤立设计中并不存在。本文通过在三个架构尺度上对自适应LIF神经元进行扩展、验证和物理实现，解决了上述两个问题。本工作的贡献包括：一个具有两级突触滤波的二阶神经元，可实现更丰富的时间动力学特性；一个具有可配置权重（100到5）的全连接6神经元脉冲网络，演示了
tldr: 该论文设计并验证了自适应LIF神经元，通过具有两级突触滤波的二阶神经元和可配置权重的6神经元全连接脉冲网络，解决了固定参数神经元缺乏生物适应机制以及多神经元网络中突触权重分配与脉冲路由的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper designs and verifies adaptive LIF neurons, addressing the lack of biological adaptation in fixed-parameter neurons and the synaptic weight distribution and spike routing challenges in multi-neuron networks, through a 2nd-order neuron with two-stage synaptic filtering and a fully-connected 6-neuron spiking network with configurable weights.
